title: coleus maculosus
intro: Coleus maculosus, commonly known as Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Coleus maculosus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Coleus maculosus include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
